verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Here at Your feet
I lay my past down

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My wanderings
All my mistakes down

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And I am free
And I am free

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Here at Your feet
I lay this day down

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Not in my strength
But in Yours I've found

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
All I need
You're all I need

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Jesus, Jesus, at Your feet
Oh, to dwell and never leave

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Jesus, Jesus, at Your feet
There is nowhere else for me
There is nowhere else for me

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Here at Your feet
I lay my future down

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
All of my dreams
I give to You now

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
And I find peace
I find peace

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
Here at Your feet
I lay my life down

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
For You my King
You're all I want now

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
'Cause I am free (here at Your feet)
All I need (is at Your feet)

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I find peace
We're at Your feet
We're at Your feet

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Here at Your feet
I lay my life down
